answer: An attester must stake 48% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the violet stake is held until the vine settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the copper audit lists each exposure. A farm running 37 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
